text: With the focus of the Clan, tansy, wild garlic, marigold, mallow, ragwort, daisies, horsetail clumps, juniper bunches, oak leaf bundles, thyme bundles, raspberry clusters, elder leaf bundles, catmint piles, moss clumps, doses of poppy seeds, cobwebs, burdock roots, plantain bundles, goldenrod, lungwort, and betony were gathered.
During the Gathering, Yewstar catches the eye of the VoleClan leader. The two regard each other carefully and, later on, the other leader makes an offer of friendship. (VoleClan relations improved.)
Yewstar is proud to be in the same Clan as Bravekit. (high positive effect)
Mallardfeather got a weird look on her face when Yewstar approached her. (low negative effect)
Prancelaurel feels comfortable challenging Tansykit on something she said. (high positive effect)
Prancelaurel feels a little safer when Lightpelt joins her in the clearing. (low positive effect)
Craneflight thinks she'll have a small litter. She's scolded into taking up a nest in the nursery, despite her best protests.
Craneflight notices that Gentleghost is fixing a damaged part of the camp without being asked. (low positive effect)
Craneflight is prancing around in front of Mosscrackle. (low positive effect)
Primfreckle lied to Nightglow's face. (high negative effect)
Primfreckle and Gracklefur always learn something new when they're together. (high positive effect)
Curryfoot tells Peatcrest that his pelt is shiny today. (low positive effect)
Archbellow is asking Peatcrest to tell him about how good he looks. (medium negative effect)
Carptail wishes he looked more like Waspkit. (medium negative effect)
Carptail wishes Fidgetmouse would lose interest in Auburnsplash. (negative effect)
Carptail overhears Suntooth humming a comforting tune. (low positive effect)
Butterflykit lets Saffronfoot know that a Clanmate was talking badly about him. (low positive effect)
Blizzardstripe draws a pretty symbol in the sand that Saffronfoot makes sure not to mess up. (low positive effect)
Oddmuzzle had a fight with Silkykit. (high negative effect)
Oddmuzzle feels like Shardtail has been quieter than usual. (low negative effect)
Hollyheart and Antlerpaw make an elaborate plan to evict a predator from the Clan's territory. (medium positive effect)
Heavythud is upset after spending the day with Hollyheart's bad attitude. (low negative effect)
Heavythud gets some good advice from Burrweb about something trivial. (low positive effect)
Heavythud tells Elmtrail, Paellapad, and Poolleaf a story that seems to grow less believable every meow. (negative effect)
Hollyheart helps Heavythud get a thorn out of his paw. (low positive effect)
Heavythud correctly warns the leader of an ambush, thanks to his clairvoyant nature.
Shardtail uses one of Flutterfeather's fears against him. (high negative effect)
Flutterfeather wishes Onemuzzle would take things more seriously. (medium negative effect)
Saltknoll and Elmtrail agree on something the rest of the Clan finds contentious. (high positive effect)
Saltknoll is wowed by how bravely Mallowpelt fought the other day. (high positive effect)
Olivebranch thinks she'll have a small litter. She moves into the nursery, grumbling her protest all the way.
Icyriver said something about a Clanmate that concerned Olivebranch. (medium negative effect)
Olivebranch invites Curryfoot, Kamautail, Craneflight, and Tomatofreckle to share what's been on their minds and to have an honest talk with each other. (positive effect)
Kamautail follows through on a small promise made with Olivebranch. (low positive effect)
Curryfoot and Olivebranch volunteer to go on an extra border patrol together. (medium positive effect)
Curryfoot eats as ravenously as a wolverine and by the time she's done, Olivebranch, Craneflight, and Kamautail barely have the stomach to finish their own meals. (negative effect)
Curryfoot is talking with Craneflight. (low positive effect)
Brinerump says something vulnerable to Tomatofreckle. (low positive effect)
Tomatofreckle tells Peatcrest, Sardinespeckle, Algaepool, and Kamautail a story that seems to grow less believable every meow. (negative effect)
Tomatofreckle warns Pebblechase about something on the ground so he doesn't trip. (low positive effect)
Tomatofreckle sneaks out at night to sleep in Kamautail's nest. (high positive effect)
Kamautail worries about how capable Snookkit is. (medium negative effect)
Kamautail and Nightglow played around during patrol and got in a bit of trouble, but still returned to camp smiling. (medium positive effect)
Petalglow makes a small sacrifice that benefits Stoatshade. (low positive effect)
Stoatshade sees that Nightglow's piece of prey looks tastier and asks if he'd like to swap. He agrees happily, saying he likes that one better. (low positive effect)
Ochretail overheard a joke from Reedheart he didn't get. (low negative effect)
Ochretail accuses Peakspore of lying about something important. (high negative effect)
Algaepool is admiring Dahliacrest from afar... (low positive effect)
Algaepool complained about his patrol assignment all day, much to the annoyance of Curryfoot, Gardeniaglow, Auburnsplash, and Skiphare. (negative effect)
Algaepool suspects Lightpelt lied about something trivial. (low negative effect)
Bravekit helps Auburnsplash hide from a Clanmate. (low positive effect)
Oddmuzzle thinks Auburnsplash is lying when she apologizes for something. (high negative effect)
Rollshock is listening to Lightpelt's woes. (medium positive effect)
Lightpelt got tricked into doing one of Warmswirl's chores. (low negative effect)
Warmswirl bumps heads with Suntooth reassuringly. (medium positive effect)
Warmswirl and Shardtail are inseparable, and can almost always be found with each other. (high positive effect)
An issue becomes benign when Amberfur remembers Reedheart's advice. (medium positive effect)
Amberfur sees that Elmtrail's piece of prey looks tastier and asks if he'd like to swap. He agrees happily, saying he likes that one better. (low positive effect)
When Fringesnap gets hurt, Pebblechase is the first to ask if he's okay. (medium positive effect)
Hushshimmer vents about something trivial to Fringesnap. (low positive effect)
Pebblechase snaps at Wavekit's annoying antics. (medium negative effect)
Pebblechase and Archbellow saw something hilarious during a patrol and can't stop giggling about it. (medium positive effect)
Peatcrest gently asks Heatherfern to turn over and winces when she does. The strain of birth isn't healing as Peatcrest had hoped it might: instead, the area looks swollen and painful.
The Clan can't believe the things Heatherfern and Midnightkit say to one another. (high negative effect)
Heatherfern didn't realize Paellapad was flirting with her. (low negative effect)
Fidgetmouse promises to always look out for Snakedrop. (high positive effect)
The Clan notices Fidgetmouse and Heatherfern share patrols more often. (medium positive effect)
Archbellow chats with Pigeonbloom about their day. (medium positive effect)
Archbellow is impressed by Quailfur helping others today. (low positive effect)
Mallowpelt and Nightglow have a misunderstanding that makes them grumpy for the rest of the day. (low negative effect)
Burrweb helps Nightglow fix a matted piece of fur on his back. (medium positive effect)
Cobaltstrike hopes to leave behind a legacy like Petalglow. (medium positive effect)
Cobaltstrike purrs for a long time at one of Pigeonbloom's lame jokes. (high positive effect)
Mallardfeather, citing queens' intuition, claims she knows she'll have a small litter. She moves into the nursery, grumbling her protest all the way.
Mallardfeather insults one of Paellapad's insecurities. (high negative effect)
Mallardfeather doubts whether Pebblechase even likes her at all... (high negative effect)
Cobaltstrike reminds Pigeonbloom to grab something from the fresh-kill pile if he hasn't already. (medium positive effect)
Pigeonbloom chats quietly with Bouncepelt while they're both on camp guard duty. (medium positive effect)
Blizzardstripe observes Heavythud carefully attending to any cat that needs help. (medium positive effect)
Blizzardstripe is prancing around in front of Auburnsplash. (low positive effect)
Primfreckle tells Bitterleaf that his pelt is shiny today. (low positive effect)
Bitterleaf spends the Gathering whispering to Pebblechase, Freezefoot, and Fidgetmouse, making it nearly impossible for anyone nearby to hear the leaders speak. (negative effect)
Lightpelt gives Bitterleaf something that he dropped. (low positive effect)
Harefeather is delighted to be working with Daisymoor today. (medium positive effect)
Harefeather and Cobaltstrike take turns in a small patch of sunlight. (medium positive effect)
Paellapad shares a joke about a neighboring Clan with Snakedrop. (low positive effect)
Pigeonbloom doesn't laugh when Paellapad does something embarrassing. (medium positive effect)
Paellapad missed a tick while grooming, and is now suffering the consequences. She has tick fever.
Dancingscreech's wound is no longer infected.
Dancingscreech overhears Pearpelt humming a comforting tune. (low positive effect)
Algaepool lets Dancingscreech know that a Clanmate was talking badly about her. (low positive effect)
Fluttershade makes plans in hopes that Lightpelt will get involved. (high positive effect)
Fluttershade overhears Fidgetmouse saying something nice about her. (high positive effect)
Gracklefur tells Daisymoor he'll save her a piece of fresh-kill. (medium positive effect)
Gracklefur had a dream about Nightglow. (low positive effect)
Peakspore goes for a nice long walk with Fidgetmouse. (medium positive effect)
Yewstar's good morning to Peakspore meant a lot to him. (low positive effect)
Skiphare keeps avoiding eye contact with Bitebone. (medium negative effect)
Bitebone eats as ravenously as a wolverine and by the time he's done, Peakspore, Bitterleaf, and Bouncepelt barely have the stomach to finish their own meals. (negative effect)
Bitebone can't help but smile seeing Dancingscreech smile. (low positive effect)
Bouncepelt feels much better: his soreness is gone.
Bouncepelt thinks the prey Midnightkit is biting into on the other side of camp looks delicious. (low negative effect)
Bouncepelt can't help but smile seeing Auburnsplash smile. (low positive effect)
Bouncepelt rolls around in some herbs after hearing Diablofoot likes their smell. (high positive effect)
Bouncepelt was on a walk when he saw Prancelaurel being attacked by a rogue! He helped Prancelaurel escape, but not before gaining a few wounds. The Clan has encountered Pigment.
Burrweb managed to recover from his heat exhaustion.
Lightpelt draws a pretty symbol in the sand that Burrweb makes sure not to mess up. (low positive effect)
Burrweb brushes against Harefeather while correcting his stance and looks away with a purr. (medium positive effect)
Burrweb was dragged out into the ocean by the tide, and inhaled a lot of water before managing to get out. He's been hacking and sputtering ever since.
Suntooth has recovered from birthing her litter.
Suntooth spent the day arguing with Hailfreckle about whether he stole something from Suntooth. (medium negative effect)
Suntooth is impressed by Yewstar helping others today. (low positive effect)
Pearpelt asks Diablofoot to look at a little cut on their leg. (high positive effect)
Pearpelt eats as ravenously as a wolverine and by the time they're done, Frondpad, Dahliacrest, and Poolleaf barely have the stomach to finish their own meals. (negative effect)
Pearpelt admires how brave Oddmuzzle is. (medium positive effect)
Pearpelt spent too long out in the sun. They've gotten heat stroke.
Quailfur laughed at Daisymoor for making a mistake on a patrol. (medium negative effect)
Pigeonbloom blamed Quailfur for their own mistake. (medium negative effect)
Diablofoot is sharing tongues with Hushshimmer. (high positive effect)
Diablofoot feels like Freezefoot has been quieter than usual. (low negative effect)
Reedheart goes for a nice long walk with Mossflight. (medium positive effect)
Reedheart wonders what he did to make Algaepool so rude towards him today. (low negative effect)
Brinerump can't run as long or as quickly as before, but he's glad that his leg healed at all.
Brinerump feels like Cobaltstrike has been quieter than usual. (low negative effect)
Verbenabloom pulled an embarrassing prank on Brinerump's friend. (low negative effect)
Though Dahliacrest asks around, she can't find Gentleghost anywhere. (low negative effect)
Dahliacrest waves to Murkhaven with her tail as their patrols cross paths on the territory. (medium positive effect)
Dahliacrest and Hushshimmer are so cuddled up and cozy in their nest they almost miss the dawn patrol.
Whiskerkit got a weird look on his face when Freezefoot approached him. (low negative effect)
When Freezefoot and Burrweb realize they've been grooming their pelts the same way, they laugh about it. (low positive effect)
Freezefoot's tail was badly injured by a dog.
The silence between Snippool and Whiskerkit feels more uncomfortable than usual. (low negative effect)
Hollyheart is upset after spending the day with Snippool's bad attitude. (low negative effect)
Gardeniaglow and Fleadusk defended their Clan at the Gathering together. (high positive effect)
Gardeniaglow is asking Heavythud interesting questions. (low positive effect)
Mossflight thinks about how to be more like Hushshimmer. (medium positive effect)
Mossflight and Kiwifoot find out they have the same favorite prey! (low positive effect)
Talonlake says something vulnerable to Hushshimmer. (low positive effect)
Hushshimmer wants to be closer to Amberfur. (low positive effect)
Shardtail has had a great time hanging out with Craneflight lately. (high positive effect)
Shardtail tromped into the warrior's den with muddy paws, trailing muck straight through Bouncepelt and Paellapad's nests. (negative effect)
Shardtail backs up one of Dahliacrest's claims during one of Dahliacrest's arguments. (high positive effect)
Shardtail has gotten fleas.
Kiwifoot is prancing around in front of Elmtrail. (low positive effect)
Kiwifoot can't help but smile when around Fleadusk. (low positive effect)
Verbenabloom appreciates Gorgekit for who she is. (medium positive effect)
Verbenabloom swears that Brindletooth's fangs are longer than usual. (medium negative effect)
Fleadusk suspects that Shardtail gets special treatment. (low negative effect)
Fleadusk spent the day arguing with Flutterfeather about whether he stole something from Fleadusk. (medium negative effect)
Skulkwillow notices that Dancingfleck seems to disappear whenever difficult tasks are being discussed. (medium negative effect)
Skulkwillow sighs at the mere mention of Onemuzzle. (high negative effect)
Algaepool helps Murkhaven hide from a Clanmate. (low positive effect)
Murkhaven had a difficult conversation with Onemuzzle, and they both ended up resentful of one another. (high negative effect)
Icyriver wonders what she did to make Nightglow so rude towards her today. (low negative effect)
When tucking in for the night, Icyriver saw that Fringesnap fixed her nest. (low positive effect)
Talonlake told all of Elmtrail's friends something embarrassing about him. (high negative effect)
Elmtrail has a discussion with Voletuft over favorite prey, and now they both have a new appreciation for each others' tastes (medium positive effect)
Quailfur believes in Brindletooth's version of events when something happens and the Clan doubts them. (high positive effect)
Shinefur doesn't believe Brindletooth when they explain that a rumor about them is false. (high negative effect)
Sardinespeckle picks some fragrant flowers for Verbenabloom. (high positive effect)
Sardinespeckle is impressed with Brindletooth's willingness to help. (medium positive effect)
Shinefur and Prancelaurel swap secrets with each other. (high positive effect)
Shinefur and Heavythud talk about a Clanmate and realize they have very different opinions on them. (medium negative effect)
Talonlake and Carnationkit find out they're both bringing flowers to the same Clanmate's grave. (high positive effect)
Voletuft complimented Talonlake on something nobody else did. (medium positive effect)
Every muscle in Frondpad's body tenses when Flightsplash walks by. (high negative effect)
Frondpad helps Voletuft figure out how to word something. (medium positive effect)
In the middle of an argument, Poolleaf tells Erminedaisy that they'll still always be friends. (high positive effect)
Poolleaf sighs loudly every time Skiphare does anything on patrol. (medium negative effect)
Pheasantbrush's friend says nice things about Archbellow, but it just makes Pheasantbrush jealous. (low negative effect)
Pheasantbrush and Talonlake saw something hilarious during a patrol and can't stop giggling about it. (medium positive effect)
Pheasantbrush was caught enjoying a moonlit stroll with Frondpad last night... (high positive effect)
Archbellow learns that Mallowpelt told a Clanmate one of his secrets. (low negative effect)
Daisymoor admits a mistake to Mallowpelt and asks for forgiveness. (high positive effect)
Onemuzzle and Snookkit can't seem to agree on the truth about something. (medium negative effect)
Onemuzzle and Icyriver couldn't agree which way to go on a patrol and got home late. (medium negative effect)
Pestofoot is disappointed when Fidgetmouse doesn't uphold a promise. (medium negative effect)
Pestofoot goes for a nice long walk with Daisymoor. (medium positive effect)
Voletuft thinks that Freezefoot is acting overly dramatic lately. (medium negative effect)
Voletuft offers to take Flightsplash's place on a patrol when he isn't feeling well. (medium positive effect)
Flightsplash thinks Pearpelt has a strange sense of humor. (medium negative effect)
Flutterfeather tells Flightsplash that he was worried about him. (low positive effect)
Flightsplash accidentally trespasses onto HickoryClan's territory.
Skiphare doesn't tell Cherrykit that she forgot to groom a part of her fur. (low negative effect)
Skiphare overhears Rollshock dispelling a false rumor about a Clanmate. (medium positive effect)
Hailfreckle wants to be closer to Primfreckle. (low positive effect)
Hailfreckle admires how brave Snakedrop is. (medium positive effect)
Shimmerrunner gets excellent advice from Poolleaf about something she had been worrying about. (high positive effect)
Shimmerrunner and Skiphare are chatting about what they're doing today. (medium positive effect)
Rollshock chats with Pearpelt while grabbing something to eat. (medium positive effect)
Rollshock is fascinated by one of Gentleghost's stories. (medium positive effect)
Even if he can't find the exact bug responsible, Rollshock's new rash and fever clearly point to tick-borne illness.
Dancingfleck tries to have a conversation with Pheasantbrush but it ends up awkward when neither of them speak up. (low negative effect)

Dancingfleck has tick fever.
Snakedrop saw Tansykit hide something before talking to him. (low negative effect)
Snakedrop and Poolleaf have a race. Poolleaf wins. (medium positive effect)
Snakedrop overdid his last sparring session and sprained a paw.
Daisymoor spent a long time talking with Fringesnap and was impressed by Fringesnap's insight. (high positive effect)
Flutterfeather's laugh reminds Daisymoor of someone she misses. (low positive effect)
Bushberry confuses Gentleghost in a conversation. (low negative effect)
Gentleghost tries to have a conversation with Rollshock but it ends up awkward when neither of them speak up. (low negative effect)
Some of the water Antlerpaw inhaled appears to be draining from his nose as well as coming up in those hacking coughs. Primfreckle puts him on nest rest to help him recover.
Antlerpaw prevents something from falling on Suntooth. (low positive effect)
Petalglow doesn't think Pestofoot's weird joke was just a joke. (medium negative effect)
Petalglow and Bushberry volunteer to go on an extra border patrol together. (medium positive effect)
Petalglow found a patch of flowering catmint! No one else is around, so she bends down and takes a big bite- — Yowch! A bee! She comes home with a swollen face...
Mosscrackle wonders why Bravekit is so pouty today. (low negative effect)
Saltknoll learns that Erminedaisy told a Clanmate one of his secrets. (low negative effect)
Bushberry and Butterflykit make fun of one another, but it sounds more like insults than playful banter. (medium negative effect)
Bushberry asks Heatherfern to go fishing with him, but they keep on getting distracted by each other. (high positive effect)
Wasppaw has reached the age of six moons and has been made an apprentice, with Shinefur as her mentor.
Wasppaw has had a lot of good dreams about Dancingscreech lately. (high positive effect)
Wavekit doesn't entertain a rumor that is being spread about Wasppaw. (medium positive effect)
As Snookpaw touches noses with Pigeonbloom, she hopes that they'll be a cool mentor that won't assign boring tasks. Anything but gathering moss or tick duty!
Snookpaw bickers with Skiphare over who gets what nest material. (low negative effect)
Snookpaw can't remember a word for the life of her, but Wavekit helps her remember it. (medium positive effect)
As Shadowpaw touches noses with Bitterleaf, he hopes that he'll be a cool mentor that won't assign boring tasks. Anything but gathering moss or tick duty!
Shadowpaw lied to Swallowkit's face. (high negative effect)
Shadowpaw gets scolded for not watching Blotchkit when Blotchkit does something naughty. (medium negative effect)
Blotchkit sees Heavythud ignore someone. (medium negative effect)
Snookpaw is not backing down in an argument with Blotchkit. (medium negative effect)
After something unsettling happens, Wavekit and Currentkit find comfort in one another's company. (high positive effect)
Wavekit wants to be closer to Snookpaw. (low positive effect)
Primfreckle lets Cherrykit stalk her tail, pretending not to see her. (medium positive effect)
Cherrykit thinks the Clan's ancestors smile upon Blotchkit. (high positive effect)

Piperkit and Wasppaw are always back-talking to each other. (high negative effect)
Drizzlekit is annoyed by Kamautail's negative comments. (low negative effect)
Drizzlekit learns that Gorgekit is scared of thunder, too. (low positive effect)
Drizzlekit woke up with a mild headache, but got up to play anyway, trying to ignore the nagging pain.
Currentkit wishes she could get her pelt to shine like Verbenabloom's. (low negative effect)
Currentkit learns that Drizzlekit is scared of thunder, too. (low positive effect)
In the middle of camp, right as she's about to pounce, Gorgekit falls to the ground and begins shaking, a seizure rolling through her little body.
Gorgekit is wowed by how bravely Mossflight fought the other day. (high positive effect)
Spittle and flecks of bone fly while Gorgekit gobbles down prey, reminding Cherrykit, Glowkit, Ospreykit, and Piperkit to seek out better mealtime companionship next time. (negative effect)
Currentkit draws a pretty symbol in the sand that Gorgekit makes sure not to mess up. (low positive effect)
Tansykit is glad to have a Clanmate like Carnationkit. (high positive effect)

Butterflykit helps Molekit get a thorn out of his paw. (low positive effect)
